#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-off merge for compose/go consolidation."""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

GO = Path("/workspaces/semio/compose/go")


def main() -> None:
    compose = (GO / "compose.go").read_text()
    kit_lines = (GO / "kit_sqlite.go").read_text().splitlines()
    # Body after kit imports (KitFromSqlite onward)
    kit_body = "\n".join(kit_lines[32:])
    kit_region = """// #region 🔖SQLite Kit Operations
// [👤compose📚go💻kitsqlite🔖sqlitekitoperations](repo://p/u/compose/b/l/go/f/main.go/s/SQLite%20Kit%20Operations)
// SQLite kit operations. MUST provide serialization and deserialization of Kit to and from SQLite and zip formats.

"""
    compose = compose.replace(
        "repo://p/u/compose/b/l/go/f/compose.go",
        "repo://p/u/compose/b/l/go/f/main.go",
    )
    # Fourth header line summary — extend to mention SQLite kit in same file
    compose = compose.replace(
        "// Core domain library in Go implementing the compose data model and operations.\n",
        "// Core domain library in Go implementing the compose data model, SQLite kit I/O, and operations.\n",
    )
    # Insert extra imports before gonum (keep stdlib grouped; gofmt will fix)
    needle = '\t"gonum.org/v1/gonum/mat"\n)'
    if needle not in compose:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected import block")
    extra = (
        '\t"archive/zip"\n'
        '\t"database/sql"\n'
        '\t"io"\n'
        '\t"net/http"\n'
        '\t_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"\n'
        "\n"
        '\t"gonum.org/v1/gonum/mat"\n)'
    )
    compose = compose.replace(needle, extra)
    out = compose.rstrip() + "\n\n" + kit_region + kit_body + "\n"
    (GO / "main.go").write_text(out)
    print("wrote main.go", len(out.splitlines()), "lines")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
